senses.gloss: m., constr. (גזר) גְּזַר decree, גְּזַר דִּין sentence, legal decision, divine dispensation.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 8b:5">Keth. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ נחתם לו ג׳ ד׳ של וכ׳</he> even if a divine decree granting seventy years of happiness were sealed to him; <cite ref="Shabbat 33a:9">Sabb. 33ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:8">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> <he>בלי שטר ובלי ג׳ ד׳</he> without a note of indebtedness and without a judicial verdict.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:8">Ib.</cite> <he>כמה גזר דין</he>, corr. <he>גִּזְרֵי דינין</he>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 3:9:23">Y. Snh. III, 21ᵈ</cite> top <he>עבדון ליה ג׳ ד׳</he> the court passes sentence over him; a. fr.—Pl. <he>גִּזְרֵי דינין</he>, <cite ref="C00520"><he>גִּיזְ׳</he></cite>. Lev. R. l. c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:3:3">Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵃ</cite> bot. (expl. <he>גזירות ב״ד</he>, Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:3">ib. III, 3</cite>) <he>אילו גי׳ ד׳</he> that means judicial verdicts.
